scope: Common prerequisite fix while clarifying the final conformance acceptance gate. Not full Draft 2020-12 support.
changes: Compare JSON numbers by canonical decimal value instead of serde_json storage variants.
Apply mathematical number equality recursively through arrays and objects for const/enum.
Recognize floating spellings with zero fractional part as integer values.
Preserve distinction between boolean/number and between integers above the exact f64 range.
Use the same numeric equality when comparing identical normalized constraints.

upstream_opencode.qualification: These upstream tests execute OpenCode, not IronMLX. Their pass does not qualify IronMLX provider compatibility. No claim that all unrelated OpenCode repository tests were run.

boundary: No commit, push, merge or real App/model execution in this prerequisite fix.
